source.author: verg
source.text: Demittunt mentes; it scissa veste Latinus, coniugis attonitus fatis urbisque ruina, canitiem immundo perfusam pulvere turpans.
source.text_original: Demittunt mentes; it scissa veste Latinus, / coniugis attonitus fatis urbisque ruina, / canitiem immundo perfusam pulvere turpans.
source.text_english: They lose heart; Latinus goes with his robe rent, aghast at his wife’s fate and the city’s ruin, defiling his gray hair, drenched with foul dust.
